name: Battle Familiar

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-2-spells.  Reference entry; bespoke effects require manual resolution. Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: Reference-only: Summon a Celestial, Fey, or Fiend Battle Familiar in Brute, Flyer, or Stalker form; see the source stat block. It acts on its own Initiative and disappears at 0 HP, your death, or spell end. Only one familiar is allowed. An existing Find Familiar companion instead transforms, retaining its type, alignment, HP, Hit Dice, and familiar features, and gaining the new form’s HP as Temporary HP; transformation ends when these run out. Slot level scales its stat block. Familiar statistics and transformation require manual resolution.
